import pytest
from subject import diff_chains, HandlerChainDiff
from omnibase_core.models.pipeline.model_chain_diff import ModelChainDiff
from omnibase_core.models.pipeline.model_golden_chain_entry import ModelGoldenChainEntry
from omnimarket.nodes.node_chain_diff_compute.models.model_chain_diff_request import (
    ModelChainDiffRequest,
)


def _entry(event_type, sequence, topic):
    return ModelGoldenChainEntry(event_type=event_type, sequence=sequence, topic=topic)


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_identical_chains_match():
    e = (_entry("A", 1, "t1"), _entry("B", 2, "t2"))
    o = (_entry("A", 1, "t1"), _entry("B", 2, "t2"))
    d = diff_chains(e, o)
    assert d.matches is True
    assert d.expected_count == 2
    assert d.observed_count == 2
    assert d.missing_events == ()
    assert d.unexpected_events == ()
    assert d.order_mismatches == ()
    assert d.topic_mismatches == ()


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_empty_chains_match():
    d = diff_chains((), ())
    assert d.matches is True
    assert d.expected_count == 0
    assert d.observed_count == 0


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_missing_event_detected():
    e = (_entry("A", 1, "t"), _entry("B", 2, "t"))
    o = (_entry("A", 1, "t"),)
    d = diff_chains(e, o)
    assert d.matches is False
    assert d.missing_events == (_entry("B", 2, "t"),)
    assert d.unexpected_events == ()
    assert d.expected_count == 2
    assert d.observed_count == 1


@pytest.mark.unit
def test_unexpected_event_detected():
    e = (_entry("A", 1, "t"),)
    o = (_entry("A", 1, "t"), _entry("C", 3, "t"))
    d = diff_chains(e, o)
    assert d.matches is False
    assert d.unexpected_events == (_entry("C", 3, "t"),)
    assert d.missing_events == ()
